protocol.design: leave-one-protein-out ridge; inner LOPO alpha selection on the 27 training proteins only; held-out protein label never used in any fit
protocol.target: b_p = ddG-space per-protein intercept, np.polyfit(ddg_true, ddg_pred, 1)[1]

baselines.mean_baseline: subtract LOPO mean of the other 27 b_p (uses NO features)
baselines.lopo_ridge: subtract ridge prediction from structure features
baselines.oracle: subtract the protein own fitted b_p -- ORACLE, not a method
